generations.name: First generation (J1)
generations.notes: 800 V. Performance Battery 79.2 kWh gross / 71.0 kWh usable (225 kW DC) and Performance Battery Plus 93.4 / 83.7 kWh (270 kW DC). Cross Turismo from MY2021 and Sport Turismo from MY2022 are body variants on the same hardware. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Porsche_Taycan

generations.name: 2025 update
generations.notes: New packs: Performance Battery 89 kWh gross / 82.3 kWh usable and Performance Battery Plus 105 / 97 kWh, DC up to 320 kW; Turbo GT added. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Porsche_Taycan
